title: In-process native Point Library catalog binding
summary: Bind an existing gemia PointLibraryPackage by semantic identity and expose read-only catalog/describe dispatch. Project edits and rendering use separate native governance.

replaceability.why: Trusted integrity and binding machinery remains controlled by Lumeri.

operations.name: compile
operations.notes: No fixed operation deadline is enforced. Checks native name/version/semantic contract hash and read surface; injects exactly the native input/output schemas. Invalid pins/authority raise ValueError without a code.

operations.name: invoke

output.description: Native ToolResult containing model from PointLibraryPackage.dispatch and ok; see iface:point.library.package/v1.

operations.notes: No fixed operation deadline is enforced. Defaults op to catalog; create/adjust/apply refused before dispatch. Remaining package-specific outputs and Python ToolResult projection are draft. Never commits Project writes.

invariants.text: The native catalog adapter refuses create, adjust and apply and grants no privileged Host API or edit authority.

break: Validation failure or an unavailable native dependency.
failure.notes: Unavailable optional native bindings are omitted and their protocols marked missing when the caller supplies a missing set; otherwise the factory error propagates. No alternate executable package is loaded.

conformance.notes: No replacement conformance runner is attached.

known_deviations.text: The binding depends on importing gemia.point_library and a built-in vector-motion package; a Luc reference cannot supply a new native implementation.
